frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Dashboard reel et notifications
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Remplacer les placeholders par un dashboard agregeant les services deja stabilises.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Content, archives, communication and finance widgets can stay mocked/empty until their phases.

frontTests.item: Dashboard displays profile, next course, calendar summary and memo/log links.
Notifications endpoint handles paginated data/meta response.
Financeur dashboard view respects hidden widgets.
Empty states display cleanly when later services are absent.

apiGatewayImpact.item: Confirm notifications collection returns consistent data/meta shape.

definitionOfDone.item: The front has a real home page for eleve and formateur.
Notifications become the common feedback surface for later phases.

frontDevelopmentPhase.workingRule: Developper par tranche verticale: API minimale reelle, ecran utilisable, tests front, verification navigateur, puis phase suivante.
